name: Orbital Settings Screen
description: Design Graph of the Orbital SettingsPage and the PageHeader instance it renders, generated from XAML, C# code-behind, and the Orbital style dictionaries the surface consumes.

sourceSummary.label: Orbital style dictionaries (brushes, surfaces, text styles, buttons, animation constants)

properties.columns: profile card full-width; about (left) and paths+actions (right) in a two-column grid with a 16px gutter

properties.implementedAs: tappable Border, not a Button control
properties.hover: code-behind swaps BorderBrush to OrbitalEmerald500_20Brush and Background to OrbitalSurface15Brush on PointerEntered, restores on PointerExited

properties.presentation: small rounded badge, OrbitalSurface2 background, 6,2 padding

properties.prefilled: loaded from SettingsService.GetStoredUsername() on page Loaded

properties.onClick: persists trimmed textbox value via SettingsService.SaveUsername

nodes.name: Display name helper text
nodes.text: This name appears in the homepage greeting.

locator.element: TextBlock Text=This name appears in the homepage greeting.

properties.structure: muted label left-aligned, value right-aligned, both OrbitalMonoSmall

evidence.rationale: Four consecutive Grids in the About card share identical structure (left OrbitalMonoSmall label in Text50, right-aligned OrbitalMonoSmall bound value in Text72), indicating one reusable label/value row concept.

locator.element: Grid with TextBlock Text=Uno Platform SDK

properties.structure: muted label stacked above a wrapping monospace path value, 8px gap

evidence.rationale: Three consecutive StackPanels in the Paths card share identical structure (OrbitalMonoSmall Text50 label over a wrapping OrbitalMonoSmall Text72 bound path), indicating one reusable stacked label-over-value field concept.

locator.element: StackPanel with TextBlock Text=Recent Projects Database
StackPanel with TextBlock Text=Claude Code Skills

properties.structure: left-aligned FontIcon (14px) + text label in a full-width ghost button

evidence.rationale: Three consecutive Buttons in the Actions card share identical structure (OrbitalGhostButtonSm style, stretched, left content alignment, horizontal StackPanel of FontIcon + TextBlock with 8px gap), indicating one reusable icon+text low-emphasis action button concept.

properties.onClick: removes all recent projects via IProjectContext, then shows a confirmation ContentDialog
opens the Orbital LocalApplicationData folder in the OS shell (external to the app; no in-app navigation)
launches external URL https://platform.uno/docs/articles/intro.html in the system browser (external to the app; no in-app navigation)

unresolved.question: What does tapping the header search bar open? SearchBorder raises the static PageHeader.SearchRequested event, but its subscriber is outside the analyzed sources.
unresolved.reason: The event is declared but no handler exists in the analyzed files; asserting a navigates-to or triggers target would be invention.

unresolved.question: Is the advertised Ctrl+K shortcut actually registered as a keyboard accelerator that raises SearchRequested?
unresolved.reason: The badge displays 'Ctrl+K' but no KeyboardAccelerator or key handler appears in the analyzed sources.

unresolved.question: What object provides the bound values (VersionDisplay, EnvStatus.UnoSdkVersion, DotNetDisplay, EnvStatus.Renderer, PlatformInfo, ProjectRoot, RecentsPath, SkillsPath), and when do they populate past their '...' fallbacks?
unresolved.reason: The bindings are declared in XAML but no DataContext assignment is visible in the analyzed sources; a loading-vs-populated state for these values would be speculative.
